items.headline: Nick Minicucci connects with Sean Wilson for 185 yards, 2 TDs as Delaware beats CCU 22-14
items.description: — Nick Minicucci threw for 302 yards and two touchdowns, with 185 yards and two scores going to Sean Wilson, and Delaware beat Coastal Carolina 22-14 on Saturday in the first meeting between the programs.

items.headline: Highlight: Vanderbilt wins up-and-down contest vs. Delaware
items.description: The Commodores open a two touchdown lead in the first quarter but go into halftime down a field goal before scoring three TDs to put the game out of reach in the third quarter, 35-26.
